results.name: priority
results.source:
import Base

type ProbeMarker is Data:
  ProbeMark{kind: Bool, text: String}

def choose(marker: ProbeMarker) -> Nat:
  match marker:
    case ProbeMark{True{}, "+"}:
      11n
    case ProbeMark{_, "+"}:
      12n
    case _:
      13n

def main() -> Nat:
  choose(ProbeMark{True{}, "+"}) * 100n + choose(ProbeMark{False{}, "+"}) * 10n + choose(ProbeMark{False{}, "other"})
